name: Silent Hill Metamorphoses
source:
The main character of the game, Eve Coulman, goes to Silent Hill looking for her missing brother.  Arriving at the place, the girl is surprised at the snowfall in early May, and having met several bizarre characters on her way, she realizes that something strange is happening to the town.

[From [url=https://jameshillten.itch.io/fan-game-silent-hill-metamorphoses]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
游戏的主角伊芙·库尔曼前往寂静岭寻找她失踪的兄弟。到达目的地后，女孩对五月初的降雪感到惊讶，并在途中遇到了几个奇怪的人物，她意识到小镇正在发生一些奇怪的事情。

[来自[url=https://jameshillten.itch.io/fan-game-silent-hill-metamorphoses]itch.io[/url]]
